My dear [[name erased](/person/1301)]
I am sending you [Keightley](/periodical/212) by this post, I must ask Macmillan to send you Pearson as I have only got a [Mudie](/organisation/137)’s copy here –[^2] I think I shall go to [Brighstone](/place/140) in Whitsunweek, when I would try to get to Bonchurch to see you

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: CMY visited the Moberlys at Brightstone in May 1869.
[^2]: Probably Thomas Keightley, The Crusaders, or, Scenes, Events and Characters from the Times of the Crusades (London: Parker, 1834).
